config:
[misc]
graphicsset = zBase
language = english.lng
[gui]
autosave = off
autosave_on_exit = false
autosave_interval = 0

msvc.flags:
CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS:STRING=/DWIN32 /D_WINDOWS /GR /EHsc
CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS_DEBUG:STRING=/Zi /Ob0 /Od /RTC1
CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS_MINSIZEREL:STRING=/O1 /Ob1 /DNDEBUG
CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS_RELEASE:STRING=/O2 /Ob2 /DNDEBUG
CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS_RELWITHDEBINFO:STRING=/Zi /O2 /Ob1 /DNDEBUG
CMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS:STRING=/DEBUG:FULL /OPT:REF /OPT:ICF /INCREMENTAL:NO
CMAKE_MSVC_RUNTIME_LIBRARY:UNINITIALIZED=MultiThreaded
OPTION_NO_LTO:UNINITIALIZED=ON
OPTION_PASSENGER_BENCHMARK:BOOL=ON
OPTION_USE_ASSERTS:BOOL=OFF
CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS-ADVANCED:INTERNAL=1
CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS_DEBUG-ADVANCED:INTERNAL=1
CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS_MINSIZEREL-ADVANCED:INTERNAL=1
CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS_RELEASE-ADVANCED:INTERNAL=1
CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS_RELWITHDEBINFO-ADVANCED:INTERNAL=1
CMAKE_GENERATOR:INTERNAL=Visual Studio 17 2022
CMAKE_GENERATOR_TOOLSET:INTERNAL=

clang.flags:
CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS:STRING=/DWIN32 /D_WINDOWS /GR /EHsc
CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS_DEBUG:STRING=/Zi /Ob0 /Od /RTC1
CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS_MINSIZEREL:STRING=/O1 /Ob1 /DNDEBUG
CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS_RELEASE:STRING=/O2 /Ob2 /DNDEBUG
CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS_RELWITHDEBINFO:STRING=/Zi /O2 /Ob1 /DNDEBUG
CMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS:STRING=/DEBUG:FULL /OPT:REF /OPT:ICF /INCREMENTAL:NO /DEFAULTLIB:"C:/Program Files (x86)/Microsoft Visual Studio/2022/BuildTools/VC/Tools/Llvm/x64/lib/clang/19/lib/windows/clang_rt.builtins-x86_64.lib"
CMAKE_MSVC_RUNTIME_LIBRARY:UNINITIALIZED=MultiThreaded
OPTION_NO_LTO:UNINITIALIZED=ON
OPTION_PASSENGER_BENCHMARK:BOOL=ON
OPTION_USE_ASSERTS:BOOL=OFF
CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS-ADVANCED:INTERNAL=1
CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS_DEBUG-ADVANCED:INTERNAL=1
CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS_MINSIZEREL-ADVANCED:INTERNAL=1
CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS_RELEASE-ADVANCED:INTERNAL=1
CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS_RELWITHDEBINFO-ADVANCED:INTERNAL=1
CMAKE_GENERATOR:INTERNAL=Visual Studio 17 2022
CMAKE_GENERATOR_TOOLSET:INTERNAL=ClangCL,host=x64
